name: GEF Small Grants Programme Panama (PPD)

administered_by.name: UNDP Panama (PNUD), with the Ministry of Environment

summary: Panama's SGP country programme funds community-based environmental projects run by registered NGOs and community organisations. The current open call supports livelihood recovery and socio-environmental resilience in Mariato.

amount.note: Indicative budgets range from USD 40,000 to USD 100,000

reporting: Grantees file a technical and financial report after each disbursement and a final report.
